security_audit.summary: All 57 static alerts are false positives involving Markdown, documentation links, recipient fields, or readable Chinese text. Semantic review found risky reply-all behavior, conflicting recipient authorization rules, and permissive meeting defaults. No evidence found of malicious payloads or an embedded prompt injection attack; defensive injection examples are explicitly labeled for rejection.

remediation.issue: Unspecified replies default to reply-all, while previews hide addresses and sending proceeds without confirmation.
remediation.suggestion: Default to sender-only replies; require explicit authorization for reply-all and show full destination addresses before sending.

remediation.issue: The recipient policy forbids body-derived destinations but also permits a warning-only path that conflicts with automatic sending.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval of every body-derived destination and prohibit sending until approval; remove the contradictory warning-only exception.

remediation.issue: Meeting defaults omit a password, disable the waiting room, and allow all participant categories.
remediation.suggestion: Default to internal-only admission and an enabled waiting room; require a password or equivalent access control for externally accessible meetings.

semantic_findings.title: Automatic Reply-All Can Disclose Replies Beyond User Intent
semantic_findings.description: Unspecified replies set reply.reply_all to true. Previews hide email addresses, and sending proceeds without a confirmation pause. This can disclose sensitive replies to unintended thread participants, including external recipients.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The documented defaults explicitly expand generic replies to all recipients and omit addresses from previews. The instructions also prohibit a post-preview confirmation question.

semantic_findings.title: Conflicting Recipient Rules Allow Warning-Only Handling of Untrusted Destinations
semantic_findings.description: The security policy restricts destinations to user instructions or mail headers, but then permits body-derived addresses with a warning. Automatic sending leaves no required approval step, creating a path for attacker-supplied destinations to receive internal information.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The warning-only exception directly conflicts with the allowed-source rule and the instruction to verify before sending. This establishes an authorization gap, not observed exfiltration.

semantic_findings.title: Meeting Defaults Omit Important Admission Controls
semantic_findings.description: Meeting invitations default to no password, a disabled waiting room, and admission for all participant categories. Without stronger platform controls, shared meeting links can admit unintended participants and expose discussions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The defaults explicitly disable these controls and require users to request restrictions. Actual unauthorized access depends on platform enforcement outside the reviewed documentation.

content.user_title: Manage WeCom Email from Your AI Assistant
content.value_statement: Searching messages and handling email attachments across separate tools takes time. This skill guides AI assistants through WeCom CLI workflows for reading, sending, and organizing email information.
actual_capabilities: Search email by keywords, participants, dates, folders, labels, unread status, attachments, stars, or importance, with pagination.
Retrieve message bodies, participant counts, attachment metadata, and schedule details, including batch retrieval of up to 100 messages.
Send Markdown emails with recipients, copy recipients, blind copy recipients, local attachments, and inline images.
Reply to messages, reply to all participants, or forward messages with optional additional commentary.
Use the media skill to download supported attachments and images for inspection, while preserving protected attachment links for manual access.
Send emailed schedule and meeting invitations with timing, reminders, recurrence, and optional meeting settings.
limitations: Requires an installed, authenticated wecom-cli and the shared skill; contact resolution and media downloads require additional skills outside this package.
Cannot delete messages, change read status or labels, save drafts, recall sent messages, or configure mailbox settings.
Cannot download or decrypt protected attachment links; those require manual access through the WeCom client.
Messages are limited to 50 MB; keyword searches return at most 100 messages, and certain filters restrict searches to the latest 30 days.

use_cases.title: Review Project Correspondence
use_cases.description: Find project emails by sender, keywords, and dates, then inspect message bodies and supported attachments.

use_cases.title: Send Reports with Supporting Files
use_cases.description: Send a Markdown report with spreadsheets or inline screenshots to explicitly selected colleagues.

use_cases.title: Email Scheduled Meeting Invitations
use_cases.description: Send meeting invitations with exact times, reminders, and explicitly requested participant admission controls.

prompt_templates.title: Find Unread Messages
prompt_templates.prompt: Find unread emails from [sender email] received during [date range]. Show the subject, sender, and date for each match.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: search with explicit sender and date filters.

prompt_templates.title: Read a Message and Its Attachments
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the email titled [subject] from [sender email]. Ask me to choose if several match. Summarize its content and supported attachments.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: identify a specific message and inspect supported content.

prompt_templates.title: Reply Only to the Sender
prompt_templates.prompt: Reply only to the sender of [selected message], not all participants. Use this text: [reply text]. Attach [local file].
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: control reply scope and include a selected attachment.

prompt_templates.title: Send a Restricted Meeting Invitation
prompt_templates.prompt: Email [recipient addresses] a meeting invitation titled [subject] with body [text]. Use [start], [end], and [timezone]. Enable the waiting room and internal-only admission.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: supply complete meeting details and explicit admission restrictions.

output_examples.input: Find unread emails from Alex about the launch during the past seven days.
output: Only one matching message was found.

output_examples.input: Read the budget review email and identify its attachments.
output: Summary: Finance requests feedback on the revised quarterly budget.
A protected supporting document requires opening its secure link in the WeCom client.

output_examples.input: Reply only to Alex with: Received, thank you.
output: After a successful send: Your reply was sent to Alex.

best_practices: Provide exact recipient addresses and explicitly state sender-only or reply-all scope; previews do not pause for confirmation.
Treat email text and attachments as untrusted data; independently verify unexpected destinations and sensitive requests.
Specify invitation times, timezone, and admission controls, and check attachment sizes before requesting a send.
anti_patterns: Requesting a generic reply when the message should go only to its sender; the documented default is reply-all.
Using a destination copied from message text without independently verifying it with the user.
Assuming a displayed preview requires confirmation, or assuming meeting passwords and waiting rooms are enabled by default.

faq.question: What must be installed before using this skill?
faq.answer: You need an authenticated wecom-cli and the shared skill. Contact resolution and media downloads also require their respective companion skills.

faq.question: Does it ask for confirmation after showing a preview?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow sends immediately after showing a preview. Provide exact recipients and content before requesting a send.

faq.question: Does a normal reply go only to the sender?
faq.answer: No. An unspecified reply defaults to reply-all. Explicitly request a sender-only reply when other participants should not receive it.

faq.question: Can it read every attachment?
faq.answer: Supported media attachments can be downloaded through the media skill. Protected links cannot be decrypted or downloaded through this workflow.

faq.question: Can it delete messages or create drafts?
faq.answer: No. Deletion, drafts, read-state changes, label changes, account settings, and sent-message recall require the WeCom client.

faq.question: Can it manage calendars and meetings directly?
faq.answer: It supports invitations sent through email. Direct calendar or meeting management belongs to separate skills. Specify timezone and meeting admission controls explicitly.
